concept.name: Brightness
concept.description: The archilexeme spanning the full scale of light intensity from pitch black through normal ambient light to blinding brightness. Uses LOG-GTCV — peak (50%) = most intense (blinding light). Full bell curve, both sides populated symmetrically.
concept.notes: v2.0: Reassigned from LOG-HL-BI to LOG-GTCV. Brightness is a degree-of-intensity concept best shown on the bell curve. 4-level cycle: TLR→TL→SL→Quiz (tests TLR/romaji). v2.1: Corrected 4 instances of a systematic romaji error in transitionsData — the adjective 暗い (kurai) must shift to its adverbial stem 暗く (kuraku) before なる/なってきた, but the romaji field incorrectly kept the dictionary form 'kurai' in front of naru-based verbs at positions 5, 15, 56, and 67. Kanji/kana text was already correct in all cases; only the romaji transliteration was wrong. v2.2 (2026-07-12): titles restructured from a broken 3-element [combined, TL, SL] shape to a proper [TLR, TL, SL] cycle, matching a template-level fix to LOG-GTCV-Generic.html (its title box previously showed hardcoded generic mode-labels on load and only ever received real content on click, with a hardcoded %4 modulo that would have hit 'undefined' past 3 supplied elements — this card's title was likely never displaying correctly at all before now). Also fixed while reconstructing: the old transitions[1]/[2] entries were the literal strings "日本語"/"English" (language names) rather than actual TL-only/SL-only renderings of the transitions title — an authoring error from when this field was first written, caught by this fix.
